subject: Claim: 5m availability gap during 2027-09-07 - verification & next steps
messages:
From: Katie Tanner <katie.tanner@clearline-pay.com>
To: mateo@redwood-inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
Cc: support@clearline-pay.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Production availability gap 2027-09-07 - request verification and credit

Hi Mateo / Marissa,

We observed a short availability gap affecting our checkout traffic today (2027-09-07) from ~15:05:20 UTC to ~15:10:40 UTC. That ~5m window resulted in failed checkout attempts and a measurable revenue impact on our side. We captured request ids and a sample trace (attached) showing repeated 503s.

Can you confirm whether this qualifies under our SLA for an availability credit and provide the exact service-side window you see? We need:
- confirmation of start/end times (UTC)
- whether this meets the SLA definition of "unavailable" vs transient errors
- expected next steps and timing for a postmortem / remediation timeline

Impact: multiple storefront checkouts failed; estimate ~2.3k checkout attempts affected between 15:05:00-15:12:00 UTC.

I've attached a small request sample (customer-incident-snippet-reqs.txt) and the customer traces for your convenience.

Thanks,
Katie Tanner
Senior Ops Manager
Clearline Payments

(attachment: customer-incident-snippet-reqs.txt)

From: mateo@redwood-inference.com <mateo@redwood-inference.com>
To: Katie Tanner <katie.tanner@clearline-pay.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com, david.kim@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 15:41:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Production availability gap 2027-09-07 - request verification and credit

Hi Katie — thanks for the report and the sample. We're looking into this now. A few quick asks so we can validate eligibility for a prorated credit: 

1) Can you confirm the business-critical endpoints that experienced the failures (e.g., /checkout/submit, /payments/authorize) — that helps map to our routing policies.
2) If you have SLO thresholds or a specific contract clause you want us to reference, paste that here; otherwise we'll run our standard availability definition from the contract (99.9% monthly availability, excluding customer-induced failures).

We're initiating a telemetry pull (traces + ingress metrics) and I'll loop David from the runtime team to extract server-side traces and pod-level events. Expect a preliminary window confirmation within 2 hours and a raw trace bundle in S3 for your team to download.

Next steps from our side:
- David will pull the node and LB logs and produce a trace bundle (I'll attach when ready).
- We'll confirm start/end (UTC) and whether the window meets SLA criteria.
- If eligible, we'll propose a prorated remedy and schedule a joint postmortem.

-Mateo
Software Reliability, Redwood Inference

From: david.kim@redwood-inference.com <david.kim@redwood-inference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com, mateo@redwood-inference.com
Cc: katie.tanner@clearline-pay.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 08:53:10 -0400
Subject: Re: Production availability gap 2027-09-07 - request verification and credit

Team — I've pulled the bundles and verified the window. Server-side traces show a cascade of 503s beginning at 15:05:18 UTC with the last clear error at 15:10:42 UTC. Autoscaler activity shows a scale-up attempt at 15:04:50 UTC that did not fully reconcile before the spike; there are also transient LB connection timeouts correlated to a regional network blip recorded by cloud provider.

Prelim timeline (UTC):
- 15:04:50 - autoscaler receives scale signal
- 15:05:18 - first 503s in service logs
- 15:10:42 - last server-side 503 observed

Based on the contract wording and our availability definition, this window meets the threshold for an SLA availability breach. I'll drop the full trace bundle in s3://redwood-inference-telemetry/CLP-4721/2027-09-07/trace_bundle.tar.gz and open internal incident INC-9273 for the RCAs and remediation tasks.

Marissa: recommended path is to offer a prorated credit per clause 2.1, schedule a joint postmortem (I can present timeline & autoscaler details), and provide a technical mitigation plan (tuning autoscaler thresholds + LB retry backoff) to prevent regression.

-David
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

(attachment: clearline_server_trace_summary.txt)

From: mateo@redwood-inference.com <mateo@redwood-inference.com>
To: Katie Tanner <katie.tanner@clearline-pay.com>

Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0400

Katie — thanks for the patience. To summarize and next steps: 

- Confirmed service-side unavailability window: 2027-09-07T15:05:18Z - 2027-09-07T15:10:42Z.
- We agree this meets the SLA definition per clause 2.1 (monthly availability).
- We've opened internal incident INC-9273 and dropped the trace bundle here for your download: s3://redwood-inference-telemetry/CLP-4721/2027-09-07/trace_bundle.tar.gz

Proposed remedy: prorated invoice credit consistent with section 2.1. Marissa will follow up with the exact credit amount and accounting path by EOD UTC. We'll schedule a joint postmortem tomorrow (I'll propose 16:00 UTC unless that conflicts with your schedule).

If that plan is acceptable, I'll move the ticket to "Adjudicated - Credit Pending" and ensure the postmortem invite goes out.

Thanks again — we're sorry for the impact and will prioritize the mitigation work.

-Mateo
